snippet.title: Escape from ToonKingdom Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Escape from Toon Kingdom - Official Early Access Trailer

Welcome to Escape from Toon Kingdom, a dark and twisted amusement park where nothing is as it seems! In this horror adventure, players must navigate eerie attractions, avoid terrifying mascots, and uncover the sinister secrets lurking within Temple Quest and its sub-attractions. Can you survive the nightmare?

Wishlist now on Steam, and get ready for the Early Access release coming in October 2024! We’re excited to hear your thoughts, and your feedback will help shape the game as we continue its development.

Features:

Explore a once-family-friendly park turned horrific
Unique attractions with chilling challenges
Hide from the menacing Crypt Giver and other terrifying foes
Community-driven development during Early Access
Be sure to report any bugs and let us know what you think! Join us on Discord and be part of the journey!
